title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Double Apple
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Double Apple Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This easy-to-use replacement pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a refreshing apple blend. Double Apple combines the crisp, slightly tart taste of Green Apple with the sweet, mellow juiciness of Red Apple for a rounded and refreshing, almost autumnal vape. Smooth and fruity with a cool, clean finish, it’s a great pick for everyday MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
